CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.billing_default_discount_pct(p_med_mrp numeric, p_med_selling numeric, p_med_discount_pct numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_med_discount_pct IS NOT NULL THEN round(least(greatest(p_med_discount_pct, 0), 100), 2)
    WHEN COALESCE(p_med_mrp, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(p_med_selling, 0) > 0 AND p_med_selling < p_med_mrp
      THEN round((p_med_mrp - p_med_selling) * 100 / p_med_mrp, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END;
$function$

    'reservation_minutes', COALESCE(s.reservation_minutes, 15),

    'gst_rates', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(rate ORDER BY rate) FROM public.gst_rate_slabs WHERE active), '[0,5,12,18,28]'::jsonb),

name: public.customer_outstanding(p_customer uuid)
detail:
returns numeric | SECURITY DEFINER | grants: authenticated,postgres,service_role
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_outstanding(p_customer uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
             AND public.my_branch_id() IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(public.my_role(), '') IN (
                'super_admin',
                'admin',
                'pharmacist',
                'billing_staff'
             )
            THEN
                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(p.amount)
                    FROM public.payments p
                    JOIN public.sales_invoices i
                      ON i.id = p.invoice_id
                    WHERE p.branch_id = public.my_branch_id()
                      AND i.branch_id = public.my_branch_id()
                      AND i.customer_id = p_customer
                      AND p.method = 'credit'
                      AND i.status = 'final'
                ), 0)

                -

                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(r.amount)
                    FROM public.customer_receipts r
                    WHERE r.branch_id = public.my_branch_id()
                      AND r.customer_id = p_customer
                      AND r.status = 'posted'
                ), 0)

                +

                COALESCE((
                    SELECT SUM(l.debit - l.credit)
                    FROM public.financial_ledger l
                    WHERE l.branch_id = public.my_branch_id()
                      AND l.account = 'receivables'
                      AND l.party_type = 'customer'
                      AND l.party_id = p_customer
                      AND l.ref_type = 'opening_balance'
                ), 0)

            ELSE 0
        END;
$function$

name: public.delivery_presence_summary()
detail:
returns jsonb | SECURITY DEFINER | grants: authenticated,postgres,service_role
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delivery_presence_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_branch uuid := public.my_branch_id();
  v_role text := public.my_role();
  v_available integer := 0;
  v_purchasing integer := 0;
  v_offline integer := 0;
  v_updated timestamptz;
  v_status text;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL
     OR v_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin', 'pharmacist', 'billing_staff', 'billing')
     OR NOT COALESCE(app.session_ok(), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'An active branch staff login is required';
  END IF;

  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.code = 'delivery_person' AND p.is_active = true AND pr.status = 'available')::integer,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.code = 'delivery_person' AND p.is_active = true AND pr.status = 'purchasing')::integer,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.code = 'delivery_person' AND p.is_active = true AND COALESCE(pr.status, 'offline') = 'offline')::integer,
    max(pr.updated_at)
  INTO v_available, v_purchasing, v_offline, v_updated
  FROM public.profiles p
  JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = p.role_id
  LEFT JOIN public.delivery_person_presence pr
    ON pr.profile_id = p.id AND pr.branch_id = v_branch
  WHERE p.branch_id = v_branch
    AND p.is_active = true
    AND r.code = 'delivery_person';

  v_status := CASE
    WHEN v_available > 0 THEN 'available'
    WHEN v_purchasing > 0 THEN 'purchasing'
    ELSE 'offline'
  END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'status', v_status,
    'available_count', v_available,
    'purchasing_count', v_purchasing,
    'offline_count', v_offline,
    'updated_at', v_updated
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delivery_set_presence(p_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_branch uuid := public.my_branch_id();
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL
     OR public.my_role() <> 'delivery_person'
     OR NOT COALESCE(app.session_ok(), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'An active delivery-person daily login is required';
  END IF;

  IF p_status NOT IN ('available', 'purchasing', 'offline') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid delivery availability status';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.delivery_person_presence(profile_id, branch_id, status, updated_at)
  VALUES (auth.uid(), v_branch, p_status, now())
  ON CONFLICT (profile_id) DO UPDATE

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expense_cancel(p_expense_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_branch uuid := public.my_branch_id();
    v_expense public.expenses%ROWTYPE;
    v_reversal uuid;
    v_count bigint;
    v_debit numeric;
    v_credit numeric;
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login and active branch required';
    END IF;

    IF coalesce(public.my_role(),'')
       NOT IN ('admin','super_admin') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorised';
    END IF;

    IF NOT coalesce(app.session_ok(),false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'An active work session is required';
    END IF;

    IF coalesce(trim(p_reason),'') = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cancellation reason is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_expense
    FROM public.expenses
    WHERE id = p_expense_id
      AND branch_id = v_branch
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expense not found in this branch';
    END IF;

    IF v_expense.status <> 'posted'
       OR v_expense.journal_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only posted expenses can be cancelled';
    END IF;

    SELECT
        count(*),
        coalesce(sum(debit),0),
        coalesce(sum(credit),0)
    INTO v_count, v_debit, v_credit
    FROM public.financial_ledger
    WHERE branch_id = v_branch
      AND journal_id = v_expense.journal_id;

    IF v_count <> 2 OR v_debit <> v_credit THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Original expense journal is missing, incomplete or unbalanced';
    END IF;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.financial_ledger
        WHERE branch_id = v_branch
          AND reversal_of = v_expense.journal_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'This expense journal has already been reversed';
    END IF;

    v_reversal := gen_random_uuid();

    INSERT INTO public.financial_ledger (
        branch_id,
        journal_id,
        entry_at,
        account,
        debit,
        credit,
        party_type,
        party_id,
        ref_type,
        ref_id,
        memo,
        reversal_of,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        branch_id,
        v_reversal,
        now(),
        account,
        credit,
        debit,
        party_type,
        party_id,
        'expense',
        v_expense.id,
        'Expense ' || v_expense.expense_no
            || ' cancellation: ' || trim(p_reason),
        v_expense.journal_id,
        auth.uid()
    FROM public.financial_ledger
    WHERE branch_id = v_branch
      AND journal_id = v_expense.journal_id;

    UPDATE public.expenses
    SET status = 'cancelled',
        reversed_journal_id = v_reversal,
        cancelled_by = auth.uid(),
        cancelled_at = now(),
        cancellation_reason = trim(p_reason),
        updated_by = auth.uid(),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_expense.id
      AND branch_id = v_branch;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
        branch_id, user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id,
        reason, before_data, after_data, at
    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch,
        auth.uid(),
        'expense_cancelled',
        'expense',
        v_expense.id::text,
        trim(p_reason),
        jsonb_build_object(
            'status','posted',
            'journal_id',v_expense.journal_id
        ),
        jsonb_build_object(
            'status','cancelled',
            'reversed_journal_id',v_reversal
        ),
        now()
    );

    RETURN v_reversal;
END;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_branch uuid := public.my_branch_id();

    v_journal uuid := gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login and active branch required';
    END IF;

    IF coalesce(public.my_role(),'')
       NOT IN ('admin','super_admin') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorised';
    END IF;

    IF NOT coalesce(app.session_ok(),false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'An active work session is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_expense
    FROM public.expenses
    WHERE id = p_expense_id
      AND branch_id = v_branch
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expense not found in this branch';
    END IF;

    IF v_expense.status <> 'draft' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only draft expenses can be posted';
    END IF;

    IF v_expense.amount <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expense amount must be positive';
    END IF;

    -- Debit the expense account.
    INSERT INTO public.financial_ledger (
        branch_id, journal_id, entry_at, account,
        debit, credit, ref_type, ref_id,

    VALUES (
        v_branch, v_journal,
        (v_expense.expense_date::timestamp
            AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),
        'expenses',
        v_expense.amount, 0,
        'expense', v_expense.id,
        'Expense ' || v_expense.expense_no
            || ': ' || v_expense.description,
        auth.uid()
    );

    -- Credit the selected payment account.
    INSERT INTO public.financial_ledger (
        branch_id, journal_id, entry_at, account,
        debit, credit, ref_type, ref_id,

    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch, v_journal,
        (v_expense.expense_date::timestamp
            AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'),
        v_expense.payment_method,
        0, v_expense.amount,
        'expense', v_expense.id,
        'Expense ' || v_expense.expense_no
            || ': ' || v_expense.description,
        auth.uid()
    );

    UPDATE public.expenses
    SET status = 'posted',
        journal_id = v_journal,
        posted_by = auth.uid(),
        posted_at = now(),
        updated_by = auth.uid(),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_expense.id

    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch, auth.uid(), 'expense_posted',

        jsonb_build_object('status','draft'),

            'expense_no',v_expense.expense_no,
            'amount',v_expense.amount,
            'payment_method',v_expense.payment_method,
            'journal_id',v_journal

        now()
    );

    v_needed := COALESCE(
        NEW.base_qty,
        NEW.qty * COALESCE(NEW.unit_factor, 1)
    );

    IF v_needed IS NULL OR v_needed <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid supplier return base quantity';
    END IF;

    -- Consume only cost layers created from this exact purchase item.
    FOR v_layer IN
        SELECT
            l.id,
            l.remaining_qty,
            l.unit_cost
        FROM public.inventory_cost_layers l
        WHERE l.branch_id = NEW.branch_id
          AND l.medicine_id = NEW.medicine_id
          AND l.batch_id = NEW.batch_id
          AND l.purchase_item_id = NEW.purchase_item_id
          AND l.remaining_qty > 0
        ORDER BY
            CASE l.layer_type
                WHEN 'paid' THEN 1
                WHEN 'free' THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END,
            l.received_at,
            l.created_at,
            l.id
        FOR UPDATE
    LOOP
        EXIT WHEN v_needed <= 0;

        v_take := LEAST(v_needed, v_layer.remaining_qty);

        UPDATE public.inventory_cost_layers
        SET remaining_qty = remaining_qty - v_take
        WHERE id = v_layer.id
          AND remaining_qty >= v_take;

        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_updated = ROW_COUNT;

        IF v_updated <> 1 THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'FIFO layer changed while processing supplier return';
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO public.inventory_purchase_return_allocations (
            branch_id,
            purchase_return_item_id,
            cost_layer_id,
            qty,
            unit_cost,
            reversed_cost
        )
        VALUES (
            NEW.branch_id,
            NEW.id,
            v_layer.id,
            v_take,
            v_layer.unit_cost,
            CASE
                WHEN v_layer.unit_cost IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE ROUND(v_take * v_layer.unit_cost, 6)
            END
        );

        v_needed := v_needed - v_take;
    END LOOP;

    IF v_needed > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Supplier return exceeds remaining original FIFO layer quantity. Unallocated base quantity: %',
            v_needed;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

returns jsonb | SECURITY DEFINER | grants: authenticated,postgres,service_role
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.invoice_detail(p_invoice uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    inv public.sales_invoices%ROWTYPE;
    r jsonb;
    f numeric;
    v_branch uuid;
    v_role text;
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required';
    END IF;

    IF NOT COALESCE(app.session_ok(), false) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'An active work session is required';
    END IF;

    v_role := COALESCE(public.my_role(), '');
    v_branch := public.my_branch_id();

    IF v_role NOT IN (
        'super_admin',
        'admin',
        'pharmacist',
        'billing_staff',
        'billing'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorised';
    END IF;

    IF v_branch IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'No branch assigned';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO inv
    FROM public.sales_invoices
    WHERE id = p_invoice
      AND branch_id = v_branch;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invoice not found in this branch';
    END IF;

    f := CASE
        WHEN inv.subtotal > 0 THEN inv.total / inv.subtotal
        ELSE 1
    END;

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'shop',
        (
            SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                'name', b.name,
                'address', b.address,
                'city', b.city,
                'state', b.state,
                'pincode', b.pincode,
                'phone', b.phone,
                'email', b.email,
                'gstin', b.gstin,
                'drug_licence', b.drug_licence_nos,
                'invoice_prefix', b.invoice_prefix,
                'footer_note', b.invoice_footer
            )
            FROM public.branches b
            WHERE b.id = v_branch
              AND b.is_active = true
        ),

        'invoice',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', inv.id,
            'invoice_no', inv.invoice_no,
            'created_at', inv.created_at,
            'subtotal', inv.subtotal,
            'discount', inv.discount,
            'tax', inv.tax,
            'total', inv.total,
            'status', inv.status
        ),

        'customer',
        (
            SELECT jsonb_build_object(
                'name', c.name,
                'phone', c.phone
            )
            FROM public.customers c
            WHERE c.id = inv.customer_id
        ),

        'items',
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(
                jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'name', m.name,
                        'strength', m.strength,
                        'batch_no', b.batch_no,
                        'expiry', b.expiry,
                        'qty', i.qty,
                        'unit_price', i.unit_price,
                        'tax_rate', i.tax_rate,
                        'line_total', i.line_total
                    )
                    ORDER BY i.id
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
            FROM public.sales_items i
            JOIN public.medicines m
                ON m.id = i.medicine_id
            JOIN public.medicine_batches b
                ON b.id = i.batch_id
            WHERE i.invoice_id = inv.id
        ),

        'payments',
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(
                jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'method', pp.method,
                        'amount', pp.amount
                    )
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
            FROM public.payments pp
            WHERE pp.invoice_id = inv.id
        ),

        'tax_summary',
        (
            SELECT COALESCE(
                jsonb_agg(
                    jsonb_build_object(
                        'rate', t.rate,
                        'taxable', t.taxable,
                        'tax', t.tax
                    )
                    ORDER BY t.rate
                ),
                '[]'::jsonb
            )
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    i.tax_rate AS rate,
                    ROUND(
                        SUM(i.line_total * f * 100 / (100 + i.tax_rate)),
                        2
                    ) AS taxable,
                    ROUND(
                        SUM(i.line_total * f * i.tax_rate / (100 + i.tax_rate)),
                        2
                    ) AS tax
                FROM public.sales_items i
                WHERE i.invoice_id = inv.id
                GROUP BY i.tax_rate
            ) t
        )
    )
    INTO r;

    RETURN r;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_purchase_return(p_invoice uuid, p_items jsonb, p_reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_branch uuid;
  v_return uuid;
  v_return_no text;
  v_item jsonb;
  v_purchase_item public.purchase_items%rowtype;
  v_batch public.medicine_batches%rowtype;
  v_qty numeric;
  v_base_qty numeric;
  v_returned numeric;
  v_line_value numeric;
  v_total numeric := 0;
begin
  v_branch := public.my_branch_id();

  if auth.uid() is null or v_branch is null then
    raise exception 'Login and active branch required';
  end if;

  if coalesce(public.my_role(), '') not in
    ('super_admin', 'admin', 'pharmacist', 'inventory_staff') then
    raise exception 'Not authorised';
  end if;

  if coalesce(trim(p_reason), '') = '' then
    raise exception 'Return reason is required';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'
     or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then
    raise exception 'Select at least one item to return';
  end if;

  -- Lock the original invoice. This serialises returns
  -- against the same purchase invoice.
  perform 1
  from public.purchase_invoices pi
  where pi.id = p_invoice
    and pi.branch_id = v_branch
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Purchase invoice not found in this branch';
  end if;

  v_return_no :=
    'PR-' ||
    to_char(now() at time zone 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYMMDD-HH24MISS') ||
    '-' ||
    upper(substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 6));

  insert into public.purchase_returns (
    branch_id,
    purchase_invoice_id,
    distributor_id,
    return_no,
    reason,
    created_by
  )
  select
    v_branch,
    pi.id,
    pi.distributor_id,
    v_return_no,
    trim(p_reason),
    auth.uid()
  from public.purchase_invoices pi
  where pi.id = p_invoice
    and pi.branch_id = v_branch
  returning id into v_return;

  for v_item in
    select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
  loop
    if coalesce(v_item->>'purchase_item_id', '') = '' then
      raise exception 'Purchase item ID is required';
    end if;

    v_qty := (v_item->>'qty')::numeric;

    if v_qty is null or v_qty <= 0 then
      raise exception 'Return quantity must be greater than zero';
    end if;

    select *
    into v_purchase_item
    from public.purchase_items p
    where p.id = (v_item->>'purchase_item_id')::uuid
      and p.invoice_id = p_invoice
      and p.branch_id = v_branch
    for update;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Purchase item not found in this invoice';
    end if;

    select coalesce(sum(pri.qty), 0)
    into v_returned
    from public.purchase_return_items pri
    where pri.purchase_item_id = v_purchase_item.id
      and pri.branch_id = v_branch;

    if v_qty > v_purchase_item.qty - v_returned then
      raise exception
        'Return quantity exceeds the remaining purchased quantity';
    end if;

    v_base_qty := v_qty * v_purchase_item.unit_factor;

    select *
    into v_batch
    from public.medicine_batches b
    where b.id = v_purchase_item.batch_id
      and b.branch_id = v_branch
      and b.medicine_id = v_purchase_item.medicine_id
    for update;

    if not found then
      raise exception 'Original purchase batch not found';
    end if;

    if v_batch.qty < v_base_qty then
      raise exception
        'Insufficient stock in batch %: available %, requested %',
        v_batch.batch_no, v_batch.qty, v_base_qty;
    end if;

    -- Allocate the original purchase line's net value
    -- proportionally, including its tax.
    v_line_value :=
      round(
        (
          (v_purchase_item.line_net / v_purchase_item.qty)
          * v_qty
        )
        * (1 + v_purchase_item.tax_rate / 100),
        2
      );

    -- Reduce batch stock exactly once.
    update public.medicine_batches
    set qty = qty - v_base_qty
    where id = v_batch.id
      and branch_id = v_branch;

    insert into public.purchase_return_items (
      branch_id,
      purchase_return_id,
      purchase_item_id,
      medicine_id,
      batch_id,
      qty,
      unit_factor,
      base_qty,
      unit_price,
      line_value
    )
    values (
      v_branch,
      v_return,
      v_purchase_item.id,
      v_purchase_item.medicine_id,
      v_purchase_item.batch_id,
      v_qty,
      v_purchase_item.unit_factor,
      v_base_qty,
      v_purchase_item.unit_price,
      v_line_value
    );

    -- Negative quantity represents stock leaving the pharmacy.
    insert into public.stock_movements (
      branch_id,
      medicine_id,
      batch_id,
      movement_type,
      qty,
      ref_type,
      ref_id,
      created_by,
      reason
    )
    values (
      v_branch,
      v_purchase_item.medicine_id,
      v_purchase_item.batch_id,
      'return_out',
      -v_base_qty,
      'purchase_return',
      v_return,
      auth.uid(),
      'Supplier return ' || v_return_no
    );

    v_total := v_total + v_line_value;
  end loop;

  update public.purchase_returns
  set total_value = round(v_total, 2)
  where id = v_return
    and branch_id = v_branch;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    branch_id,
    user_id,
    action,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    reason,
    before_data,
    after_data,
    at
  )
  values (
    v_branch,
    auth.uid(),
    'purchase_return_created',
    'purchase_return',
    v_return::text,
    trim(p_reason),
    null,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'return_id', v_return,
      'return_no', v_return_no,
      'purchase_invoice_id', p_invoice,
      'total_value', round(v_total, 2)
    ),
    now()
  );

  return v_return;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(purchase_item_id uuid, medicine_id uuid, medicine_name text, batch_id uuid, batch_no text, purchased_qty numeric, returned_qty numeric, remaining_qty numeric, unit_factor numeric, base_qty numeric, unit_price numeric, tax_rate numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_branch uuid;
  v_role text;
BEGIN
  v_branch := public.my_branch_id();
  v_role := public.my_role();

  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login and active branch required';
  END IF;

  IF COALESCE(v_role, '') NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorised';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.purchase_invoices pi
    WHERE pi.id = p_invoice
      AND pi.branch_id = v_branch
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Purchase invoice not found in this branch';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.medicine_id,
    m.name::text,
    p.batch_id,
    b.batch_no::text,
    p.qty,
    COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0),
    GREATEST(p.qty - COALESCE(r.returned_qty, 0), 0),
    p.unit_factor,
    p.base_qty,
    p.unit_price,
    p.tax_rate
  FROM public.purchase_items p
  JOIN public.medicines m
    ON m.id = p.medicine_id
   AND m.branch_id = v_branch
  JOIN public.medicine_batches b
    ON b.id = p.batch_id
   AND b.branch_id = v_branch
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      pri.purchase_item_id,
      SUM(pri.qty) AS returned_qty
    FROM public.purchase_return_items pri
    WHERE pri.branch_id = v_branch
    GROUP BY pri.purchase_item_id
  ) r ON r.purchase_item_id = p.id
  WHERE p.invoice_id = p_invoice
    AND p.branch_id = v_branch
  ORDER BY m.name, b.batch_no;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_customer_receipt(p_customer uuid, p_amount numeric, p_method text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_branch uuid := public.my_branch_id();
    v_customer public.customers%rowtype;
    v_id uuid;
    v_no text;
    v_journal uuid;
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login and active branch required';
    END IF;

    IF COALESCE(public.my_role(), '') NOT IN (
        'super_admin',
        'admin',
        'pharmacist',
        'billing_staff'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorised';
    END IF;

    IF p_amount IS NULL
       OR p_amount <= 0
       OR p_method NOT IN ('cash', 'upi') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Enter a positive amount and choose Cash or UPI';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_customer
    FROM public.customers
    WHERE id = p_customer
      AND branch_id = v_branch
      AND active = true
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Customer not found or inactive in this branch';
    END IF;

    -- Overpayments are now allowed.
    -- The excess becomes a customer advance (credit receivable).

    v_no := public.finance_next_doc('RCPT');

    INSERT INTO public.customer_receipts (
        branch_id,
        receipt_no,
        customer_id,
        amount,
        method,
        note,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch,
        v_no,
        p_customer,
        p_amount,
        p_method,
        NULLIF(TRIM(p_note), ''),
        auth.uid()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_id;

    v_journal := public.post_journal(
        'customer_receipt',
        v_id,
        'Receipt ' || v_no || ' from ' || v_customer.name,
        jsonb_build_array(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'account', p_method,
                'debit', p_amount,
                'credit', 0
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'account', 'receivables',
                'debit', 0,
                'credit', p_amount,
                'party_type', 'customer',
                'party_id', p_customer
            )
        )
    );

    UPDATE public.customer_receipts
    SET journal_id = v_journal
    WHERE id = v_id
      AND branch_id = v_branch;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
        branch_id,
        user_id,
        action,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        reason,
        before_data,
        after_data,
        at
    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch,
        auth.uid(),
        'customer_receipt_recorded',
        'customer_receipt',
        v_id::text,
        'Customer dues receipt',
        NULL,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'receipt_no', v_no,
            'customer_id', p_customer,
            'amount', p_amount,
            'method', p_method
        ),
        now()
    );

    RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

        RAISE EXCEPTION

    END IF;

    IF p_purchase IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.purchase_invoices
        WHERE id = p_purchase
          AND branch_id = v_branch
          AND distributor_id = p_distributor
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Purchase invoice does not belong to this distributor and branch';
    END IF;

    -- Overpayments are now allowed.
    -- The excess creates a distributor debit balance (advance).

    v_no := public.finance_next_doc('SP');

    INSERT INTO public.supplier_payments (
        branch_id,
        payment_no,
        distributor_id,
        purchase_invoice_id,
        amount,
        method,
        reference,
        note,
        created_by
    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch,
        v_no,
        p_distributor,
        p_purchase,
        p_amount,
        p_method,
        NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference), ''),
        NULLIF(TRIM(p_note), ''),
        auth.uid()
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_id;

    v_journal := public.post_journal(
        'supplier_payment',
        v_id,
        'Payment ' || v_no || ' to ' || v_distributor.name,
        jsonb_build_array(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'account', 'payables',
                'debit', p_amount,
                'credit', 0,
                'party_type', 'distributor',
                'party_id', p_distributor
            ),
            jsonb_build_object(
                'account', p_method,
                'debit', 0,
                'credit', p_amount
            )
        )
    );

    UPDATE public.supplier_payments
    SET journal_id = v_journal
    WHERE id = v_id
      AND branch_id = v_branch;

    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
        branch_id,
        user_id,
        action,
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        reason,
        before_data,
        after_data,
        at
    )
    VALUES (
        v_branch,
        auth.uid(),
        'supplier_payment_recorded',
        'supplier_payment',
        v_id::text,
        'Supplier payment',
        NULL,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'payment_no', v_no,
            'distributor_id', p_distributor,
            'amount', p_amount,
            'method', p_method
        ),
        now()
    );

    RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_party_opening_balance(p_entry_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_branch uuid := public.my_branch_id();
    v_entry public.party_opening_balances%rowtype;
    v_reversal_journal uuid := gen_random_uuid();
    v_line_count integer;
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_branch IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Login and active branch required';
    END IF;

    IF COALESCE(public.my_role(), '') NOT IN (
        'super_admin',
        'admin'
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Admin can reverse opening balances';
    END IF;

    IF COALESCE(TRIM(p_reason), '') = '' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'A reversal reason is required';
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_entry
    FROM public.party_opening_balances
    WHERE id = p_entry_id
      AND branch_id = v_branch
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Opening balance not found in this branch';
    END IF;

    IF v_entry.status <> 'posted' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Opening balance is already reversed';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*)
    INTO v_line_count
    FROM public.financial_ledger
    WHERE branch_id = v_branch
      AND journal_id = v_entry.journal_id;

    IF v_line_count <> 2 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Original opening journal is missing or invalid';
    END IF;

    -- Reverse the original journal by appending opposite entries.
    INSERT INTO public.financial_ledger (
        branch_id,
        journal_id,
        entry_at,
        account,
        debit,
        credit,
        party_type,
        party_id,
        ref_type,
        ref_id,
        memo,
        reversal_of,
        created_by
    )
    SELECT
        branch_id,
        v_reversal_journal,
        now(),
        account,
        credit,
        debit,
        party_type,
        party_id,
        'opening_balance',
        v_entry.id,
        'Opening balance reversal: ' || TRIM(p_reason),
        v_entry.journal_id,
        auth.uid()
    FROM public.financial_ledger
    WHERE branch_id = v_branch
      AND journal_id = v_entry.journal_id;

    UPDATE public.party_opening_balances
    SET status = 'reversed',
        reversal_journal_id = v_reversal_journal,
        reversed_by = auth.uid(),
        reversed_at = now(),
        reversal_reason = TRIM(p_reason)
    WHERE id = p_entry_id
      AND branch_id = v_branch;

    RETURN v_reversal_journal;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_branch_profile(p_data jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_branch_id uuid;
    v_rows integer;
    v_before jsonb;
    v_after jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT app.session_ok() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'An active work session is required'
            USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;

    IF COALESCE(public.my_role(), '')
       NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only an administrator can update pharmacy details'
            USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;

    v_branch_id := app.branch_id();

    IF v_branch_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'No active branch is assigned'
            USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;

    IF p_data IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_data) <> 'object' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid pharmacy details';
    END IF;

    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'name'), '') IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pharmacy name is required';
    END IF;

    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'invoice_prefix'), '') IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invoice prefix is required';
    END IF;

    IF p_data ? 'drug_licence_nos'
       AND jsonb_typeof(p_data->'drug_licence_nos') <> 'array' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Drug licence numbers must be a list';
    END IF;

    -- Capture the current branch details and lock the row.
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'name', name,
        'address', address,
        'city', city,
        'state', state,
        'pincode', pincode,
        'phone', phone,
        'email', email,
        'gstin', gstin,
        'drug_licence_nos', drug_licence_nos,
        'invoice_prefix', invoice_prefix,
        'invoice_footer', invoice_footer
    )
    INTO v_before
    FROM public.branches
    WHERE id = v_branch_id
      AND is_active = true
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active branch details not found'
            USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;

    -- Update only the current active branch.
    UPDATE public.branches
    SET
        name = BTRIM(p_data->>'name'),
        address = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'address'), ''),
        city = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'city'), ''),
        state = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'state'), ''),
        pincode = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'pincode'), ''),
        phone = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'phone'), ''),
        email = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'email'), ''),
        gstin = NULLIF(UPPER(BTRIM(p_data->>'gstin')), ''),
        drug_licence_nos =
            COALESCE(p_data->'drug_licence_nos', '[]'::jsonb),
        invoice_prefix = BTRIM(p_data->>'invoice_prefix'),
        invoice_footer = NULLIF(BTRIM(p_data->>'invoice_footer'), '')
    WHERE id = v_branch_id
      AND is_active = true;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;

    IF v_rows <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'The active branch could not be updated'
            USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;

    -- Capture the updated details.
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'name', name,
        'address', address,
        'city', city,
        'state', state,
        'pincode', pincode,
        'phone', phone,
        'email', email,
        'gstin', gstin,
        'drug_licence_nos', drug_licence_nos,
        'invoice_prefix', invoice_prefix,
        'invoice_footer', invoice_footer
    )
    INTO v_after
    FROM public.branches
    WHERE id = v_branch_id;

    -- Record only genuine changes.
    IF v_before IS DISTINCT FROM v_after THEN
        INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (
            branch_id,
            user_id,
            action,
            entity_type,
            entity_id,
            reason,
            before_data,
            after_data,
            at
        )
        VALUES (
            v_branch_id,
            auth.uid(),
            'pharmacy_profile_updated',
            'branch',
            v_branch_id::text,
            'Pharmacy profile updated',
            v_before,
            v_after,
            now()
        );
    END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_work_session()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_branch uuid;
  v_timezone text;
begin
  if v_user is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required';
  end if;

  select p.branch_id, b.timezone
    into v_branch, v_timezone
  from public.profiles p
  join public.branches b on b.id = p.branch_id
  where p.id = v_user
    and p.is_active = true
    and p.must_change_password = false
    and b.is_active = true;

  if v_branch is null then
    raise exception 'Active staff profile and branch required';
  end if;

  -- Close previous active sessions for this user.
  update public.work_sessions
  set logout_at = now(),
      logout_reason = 'new_login'
  where user_id = v_user
    and logout_at is null;

  -- Create today's work session.
  insert into public.work_sessions (
    user_id,
    branch_id,
    work_date,
    login_at,
    last_activity_at
  )
  values (
    v_user,
    v_branch,
    (now() at time zone v_timezone)::date,
    now(),
    now()
  );

  return true;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_work_session()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'app', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_updated integer;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.work_sessions ws
     SET last_activity_at = now()
   WHERE ws.user_id = auth.uid()
     AND ws.logout_at IS NULL
     AND ws.work_date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM public.profiles p
       WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
         AND p.is_active = true
         AND p.branch_id = ws.branch_id
         AND p.must_change_password = false
     );

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_updated = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_updated > 0;
END;
$function$
